Ultratech Cement Limited has informed the Exchange vide its letter dated October 06, 2009, that: "A meeting of the Board of Directors ("Board") of Ultratech Cement Limited (the "Company") was held in Mumbai today, at which the Board of the Company deliberated upon the proposal received from Samruddhi Cement Limited ("Samruddhi") in relation to a potential consolidation of Samruddhi and the Company. The Board, having found the proposal attractive, constituted and authorized a Committee of Directors and Officers of the Company to inter alia evaluate and consider the proposal in consultation with legal and financial advisors.
